description:
Do you love Biscoff as much as we do??

If you do, you must try this Cookies n Cream ice cream using biscoff spread and sandwich cookies. 

500ml Milk
400ml Cream
160g Sugar
1 Pack of Biscoff Sandwich Cookies
200g Biscoff Spread

The ice cream has so much Biscoff flavour and the cookies give a perfect crunch throughout. 
Why not give this one a try and let us know how it goes. 


If you enjoyed this video, please consider liking and subscribing, plus pop over to our Instagram and Facebook pages linked below and say hello :)

Instagram: https://tinyurl.com/2p85zcxh
Facebook: http://tiny.cc/mmxosz
Website: https://polaricecreamery.com/


Thanks and see you on the next video :)

#biscoff #cookiesncream #icecream #icecreamrecipe #gelato #food #foodie

comments.text: Ended up making this last night. Super easy. It ended up with a 1 1/2 pints of base so I likely need to scale a bit for a second go in the future to get two full (or three) pints. Thanks again for the super simple to execute recipes.

comments.text: I took my half batch and did a bit of a mod. It was the Biscoff Ice Cream, Biscoff cookies (non-filled), and Guittard Baking Chips, 63% Extra Dark. Such a lovely combination.

comments.text: Nice, Biscoff chocolate sounds yummy.

comments.text: Thnx for sharing this recipe. I made this one today with just propotionately adjusting the ingredients for 250ml cream. The cream I use is 35% fat and milk is 3.25% fat. I just added 1g of Xanthan gum. However, I feel a thin layer of cream/fat lingering on the spoon as I'm eating it. Just wondering what you think could be the issue ? Could it be that the Lotus Biscoff spread I'm using is having a higher fat content than yours or if the heavy cream should be reduced a bit. Also I felt that ice cream froze a touch hard and not having that silky smooth glossy texture. Thanks
comments.author: @usman_oz

comments.text: You’ll likely just need to reduce the fat content slightly. It’s a rich high fat recipe but was never greasy. Let me run the numbers and I’ll come back to you. Message me on Patreon or Ko-Fi so I don’t forget 👍
comments.author: @PolarIceCreamery

comments.text: Ok, UK cream is very different to other counties. Because of that, reduce the cream to 400ml and keep everything else the same. You could even drop the cream to 300 and see how that works for you. I’ve adjusted the recipe to suit.
comments.author: @PolarIceCreamery

comments.text: Thanks for the effort & time for replying. Probably will recreate with the adjustment as you suggested and will update here in few days. Thanks
comments.author: @usman_oz

comments.text: This is my new favourite ice cream! You're absolutely right about avoiding being cheap on the Lotus Biscoff cookie bits. I modified the Salt & Straw base recipe removing the corn syrup in place of the speculoos cookie butter. The ice cream is very rich and smooth. Thank you for posting this video. The recipe I tried:  1/2 cup granulated sugar (100 g), 2 tbsp milk powder (15g ), 1/4 tsp xanthan gum, 5 tbsp Penotti speculoos cookie butter (100 g), 1 1/2 cups 2% milk (330 g), 1 1/3 cup 35% cream (300 g), 1 tsp vanilla.
comments.author: @logandonaldson
